item.title: Women's Circle - Sovereign in the Spotlight, A Solar Eclipse — Fri Aug 14, 6:30 PM — Yoga Mechanics at 107 Forest Street
item.description:
Women’s Circle is a monthly gathering for women to come together in a supportive, intentional space. Each month centers on a new theme, offering time for reflection, connection, and shared growth. New participants are always welcome. We suggest bringing a journal and a small object that reflects the month’s theme. This might be a photo, token, or meaningful item that helps ground your experience. Not sure what to expect? We’ll circle up with other identifying women for guided conversation, reflection, and ritual. With Connie’s facilitation, the evening is designed to help you reconnect with yourself and with one another. Expect to leave feeling refreshed, grounded, and supported as you move through the season ahead. Financial Assistance is available. Reach out if you have any questions: info@yogamechanics.com Share this: Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook

item.title: Montclair Mixtape: Build-a-Zine with WMSC — Wed Aug 19, 3:00 PM — University Hall Room 2044
item.description: What if you could bottle up the very beginning of your Montclair story? Montclair Mixtape is a collaborative Welcome Week zine where every student gets to create a page that captures who they are right now—their favorite songs, big goals, random interests, and everything they hope to experience during their first year at Montclair. Then, make it yours! Decorate your page with stickers, doodles, magazine cutouts, colors, lyrics, photos, or anything else that feels like you. While creating, students can chat, swap recommendations, discover shared interests, and get to know the people around them. Throughout Welcome Week, pages will be collected and brought together into one giant collaborative “Montclair Mixtape” zine—a snapshot of the students, dreams, personalities, and playlists that make up YOUR first week on campus. With student permission, the finished zine can be shared digitally through Canva, creating a time capsule students can revisit long after Welcome Week is over. Because y

item.title: Inner Body Meditation (20 minutes) — Thu Aug 20, 9:30 PM
item.description:
The Mindful Stream "Awareness of the inner body takes you beyond the mind." - Eckhart Tolle
In this mediation session we will bring our attention here: to the inner body. Sessions are suitable for newcomers, those experienced in Tolle's teachings and anyone wishing to remain completely anonymous. They will last around 20 minutes and cameras and microphones will be disabled. (Depending on the situation, a free discussion may be held at the end with mics and cameras allowed.)
See you there!
Please be aware that sessions will close if no members have joined after 10 minutes.
Emrys also organises a free Work of Byron Katie online mediation group. Visit [this Meetup Group link](https://www.meetup.com/thework-runsfree/) for more information.21
Source: Meetup: The Mindful Stream

item.title: "Bracelets for Warriors" - Bracelet-Making Workshop focusing on Heart Health — Sat Aug 29, 10:30 AM — Nutley - Stockton Room
item.description:
On Saturday August 29 at 10:30 AM, we will host a family-friendly bracelet-making workshop from Bracelets for Warriors, led by Joyce Cortez, a rising senior this year at Paramus Catholic.
What’s included?
Create your own bracelet to take home! Learn simple, age-appropriate heart health tips Hear the inspiring story behind Bracelets for Warriors
This program is ideal for kids in grades 2-5, but kids in grades K-1 may participate as well with adult support.
Space is limited to only 25 participants; registration is required!
Joyce designed this community initiative after her dad's open heart surgery. Her goal is to educate youth and families about the importance of heart health, while offering a positive and creative experience they will love. Her presentation includes information on what the heart does and how to introduce habits to keep your heart healthy.
Source: Libcal Bccls 10315

item.title: PRE-ADVENT BEGINS — Sun Nov 8
item.description: At Holy Spirit Verona we share in three weeks of "Pre-Advent" -- the three Sundays between All Saints and Advent 1. During this time we encourage you to take an intentional “pause” before the waiting and preparing of Advent. Advent used to be seven weeks, up until the 7th century, and there is a small movement within the Church to return to that (see theadventproject.org). Many of the scripture readings and prayers after All Saints give a hint or lean towards Advent, so Father Jerry says... why not just go there!Yes, we all know Father Jerry loves Advent. We are not bringing forth Christmas early like many retailers do, but rather allowing an intentional time to PAUSE before the all-consuming month of December. These three weeks of Pre-Advent, we hope, will bring forth a level of preparation and space during Advent which will make Christmas that much more meaningful.
